search_text: published ZDI-20-1406 ZDI-CAN-11828 Apple macOS CoreText MorxLigatureSubtableBuilder TTF Parsing Out-of-Bounds Write Remote Code Execution Vulnerability 2020-12-08 CVE-2020-9999 https://www.cve.org/CVERecord?id=CVE-2020-9999 7.8 AV:L/AC:L/PR:N/UI:R/S:U/C:H/I:H/A:H ['Apple'] ['macOS'] This vulnerability allows remote attackers to execute arbitrary code on affected installations of Apple macOS. Interaction with the CoreText library is required to exploit this vulnerability but attack vectors may vary depending on the implementation. The specific flaw exists within the parsing of TTF fonts. Crafted data in a TTF file can trigger a write past the end of an allocated data structure. An attacker can leverage this vulnerability to execute code in the context of the current process. This issue was addressed in macOS Big Sur 11.0.1. title: Apple macOS CoreText MorxLigatureSubtableBuilder TTF Parsing Out-of-Bounds Write Remote Code Execution Vulnerability
vulnerability_details: This vulnerability allows remote attackers to execute arbitrary code on affected installations of Apple macOS. Interaction with the CoreText library is required to exploit this vulnerability but attack vectors may vary depending on the implementation. The specific flaw exists within the parsing of TTF fonts. Crafted data in a TTF file can trigger a write past the end of an allocated data structure. An attacker can leverage this vulnerability to execute code in the context of the current process.
